children: U.S. third-quarter GDP and September PCE data are due Thursday, while Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon are scheduled to report earnings next week. According to PANews, citing Jin10, the Federal Reserve will announce its rate decision at 02:00 (UTC+8) on Thursday, followed by a monetary policy press conference with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at 02:30. At 20:30, the U.S. is scheduled to release its preliminary annualized third-quarter GDP growth, September core and headline PCE inflation rates, weekly jobless claims through October 24, and September personal spending. The eurozone’s October industrial confidence and final consumer confidence readings are due at 18:00. Friday’s calendar includes the October Chicago PMI at 21:45. Europe switches to winter time on October 25.

Microsoft and Alphabet are scheduled to report after the U.S. market closes on Wednesday, with Amazon due after the close on Thursday. Other earnings include Verizon on Monday; Boeing and Coca-Cola before the market opens Tuesday and Visa after the close; Intel after the close Thursday; SK Hynix on Wednesday; and Samsung Electronics on Thursday.

The report also recounted market moves from the past week: U.S. chip and AI-related stocks rebounded early in the week as investment rotated toward healthcare and financial shares. Meta’s capital spending plan renewed concerns about AI valuations and returns on Wednesday, and a selloff spread across technology stocks on Thursday, sending safe-haven flows into U.S. Treasuries and the yen. Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities pushed Brent crude to a five-month high that day.

title: Next Week: U.S. Q3 GDP and September PCE Due as Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon Report
